cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WITH count(d) AS totalDocs MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d2:Document) WITH totalDocs, d2, sum(c.char_count) AS totalChars, count(c) AS chunkCount ORDER BY totalChars DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN totalDocs, d2.doc_id AS topDoc, d2.title AS topTitle, chunkCount, totalChars
note: Count all Document nodes, then aggregate char_count per document via PART_OF chunks to find the largest by total content.

cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk) RETURN c.provenance AS provenance, count(c) AS chunkCount, sum(c.char_count) AS totalChars ORDER BY totalChars DESC
note: Group all chunks by their provenance property (e.g. SYNTHESIZED vs vendor-grounded) and sum char_count to show corpus proportion.
